g.text: Participants: gui = UsedCarGUI; cli = UsedCarCLI; facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade; agent = UsedCarAgent; tools = ToolManager.
knowledgeTool = VehicleKnowledgeTool; repository = VehicleKnowledgeRepository; checker = DataQualityChecker; constraintTool = ConstraintCheckerTool.
riskPanel = RiskEvaluationPanel; worker = its SwingWorker<RiskEvaluation, Void>; evaluateCmd = EvaluateVehicleCommand; factory = EvaluationStrategyFactory.
policy = EvaluationStrategy (Balanced / ReliabilityFocused automatically; BudgetFocused also available manually). Manual mode reuses the selected policy.
Quality distinguishes missing / uncertain from known negative history. Constraints: budget, mileage, transmission, accident tolerance; no body-type rule.
new RiskEvidence(v, p, m, k, f, c, guidance, limits, constraintsAvailable, Year.now(clock).getValue())
Local knowledge absent / failed → explicit limitation. Constraint-tool failure → constraintsAvailable=false.
c is the existing optional CostEstimate; no CostCalculatorTool or new assumptions in F08.
listingNeeds nonempty → add unresolved claims to uncertainty; m.sufficient=false. Then continue at B1.
ref A1 agent → tools → knowledgeTool → repository → k
sd A3 — agent.evaluateRisk(v, p, c, listingNeeds): evidence first
CLI evaluate calls the same command synchronously.
synchronized(session): capture contextVersion, current Vehicle v,
saved UserPreference p and listingClarifications; clearRisk().
No saved vehicle → IllegalStateException; no agent/model call.
After leaving lock: session.getCost().orElse(null) supplies c.
Unsaved form edits are not evaluation input.
GUI/CLI show error; saved session preserved.
F08 instead records a limitation and may continue.
Empty issues / notes; explicit no local data.
No model-specific reliability facts are invented.
ref A1 outcomes — mutually exclusive; direct F05 ends here, without a model call
sd A1 — F05 direct retrieval; shared repository subflow reused by F08
